video.title: house-planner mobile PV v5 — exact-first layered master
video.purpose: A 32-second product film that completes its story with exact product footage and uses approved generative material only as replaceable quality-enhancement layers.
video.audience: Japanese prospective detached-home owners and, secondarily, housing and design professionals

references.role: same position with another look direction
approved same-house high-quality foyer and stair image
optional enhancement replacement; not required for the base master

global_instructions.brand: house-planner mobile. Use warm off-white, coral, sky blue and charcoal. Composite exact logo and typography only in deterministic editing.
global_instructions.continuity: Preserve the exact assets/default_plan.json house in every shot. Never use or reference exterior-beauty-candidate-01 through 04 because they do not match the designed building.
global_instructions.text_policy: Do not generate UI, text, logos, QR codes or watermarks inside generative frames.
global_instructions.audio: Restrained modern pulse, real UI clicks, a light cumulative stacking rise, quiet interior room tone, and a three-note brand resolve.

shots.purpose: Begin with a real 1F plan edit
shots.visible_change: Edit one wall or opening once in the actual product
shots.outgoing_handoff: Match the edited line into the main 2F line
shots.action: Record the before state, one action and settled result
shots.on_screen_text: A home begins with one line.
shots.negative_prompt: Generated UI, generated plan, fake cursor action

shots.purpose: Show that the plan continues from 1F to 2F
shots.visible_change: Use the real floor control once and settle on 2F
shots.outgoing_handoff: Carry 1F and 2F linework into a stacked composition
shots.action: Prove 1F, the actual control action, and settled 2F inside the recorded pixels
shots.negative_prompt: Pretending a still change is product interaction, generated UI

shots.visible_change: 1F plan to 2F plan to stacked lines to the exact live 3D house
shots.outgoing_handoff: Carry the same roof edge into exterior review
shots.action: Use only exact plans and live 3D. Replace the final 0.8–1.2 seconds only if exterior_v2_approved later passes review.
shots.prompt: No generation in the base master.
shots.negative_prompt: Different house, invalid generated exterior, generated plan text

shots.visible_change: Cut between three-quarter, east and north views
shots.outgoing_handoff: Match a dark facade line into the interior divider
shots.action: Use short exact-product match cuts. Replace no more than two cuts only after exact v2 exterior approval.
shots.prompt: No generation in the base master.
shots.negative_prompt: Repeated first view, different house, altered roof or openings

shots.visible_change: Reveal the oblique view while keeping stair, kitchen, sofa and dining legible
shots.outgoing_handoff: Match stair and oak-floor lines into seated walkthrough
shots.action: The base master uses exact captures. Use a Topview section only if all geometry remains fixed.
shots.prompt: Treat the current product captures as exact architectural evidence. Preserve every wall, stair, opening, kitchen component, sofa, table and floor boundary. If motion is added, lower the camera only slightly with less than an 8-degree arc and no geometry morph.
shots.negative_prompt: Altered stair, wall, opening, kitchen, furniture, generated UI, people, text

shots.purpose: Show floor and distance from a seated living viewpoint
shots.visible_change: Cut to the utility side and a second direction from the same validated position
shots.outgoing_handoff: Carry the foyer oak floor into the high-quality foyer
shots.camera: Lock seated eye height and keep the floor visible
shots.on_screen_text: At the eye level of everyday life.
shots.negative_prompt: Standing-height rise, camera inside walls or furniture, arbitrary minimap teleport

shots.purpose: Resolve the same exact foyer into an approved high-quality view
shots.incoming_state: Exact seated product view of the foyer
shots.visible_change: Dip briefly through warm white and reveal the approved foyer beauty image
shots.outgoing_handoff: Match oak floor and white walls into the LDK
shots.camera: Seated height; never rise or tilt
shots.action: The base master uses the approved still. Replace with T51 only after review.
shots.prompt: Use beauty_foyer as the sole final architectural truth and walk_foyer as exact seated-camera evidence. Preserve the exact stair count and turn, corridor width, door locations, cabinet, floor, walls and lighting relationship. Make only a stabilized seated-eye dolly forward under 30 centimeters. No camera rise, no tilt, no object motion, no cuts.
shots.negative_prompt: Changed stair count, wider corridor, moved door, moved cabinet, people, added objects, text, logo, UI, morphing

shots.incoming_state: Warm oak and white-wall palette from S07
shots.visible_change: Cut to the approved LDK and hold calmly
shots.outgoing_handoff: Carry window light into the end card
shots.camera: Locked or less than a 3% push
shots.action: The base master uses the approved still. Replace with T52 only after review.
shots.prompt: Use beauty_ldk as the sole final architectural truth and interior_oblique as exact spatial evidence. Lock the stair divider, stair turn, kitchen sink and hob order, sofa and chaise, coffee table, dining set, balcony opening and all walls. Add only less than a 3% stabilized push and very subtle daylight breathing. No furniture or object motion.
shots.negative_prompt: Different plan, moved furniture, changed divider, changed stair, shifted opening, generic luxury-house replacement, people, text, logo, UI

shots.visible_change: Lift into warm off-white and composite the official logo and exact Japanese copy
shots.action: Composite the official asset and exact typography
shots.on_screen_text: house-planner mobile / 描く。確かめる。暮らしが見える。
shots.negative_prompt: Generated logo, generated text, altered brand mark

edit.transition_notes: The base master never depends on an unapproved exterior. Generative material may replace only the end of S03, part of S04, and approved motion slots in S05, S07 and S08.
edit.music_notes: Build cumulatively in S03, open spatially in S05, reach the warmest point in S07–S08, and land the brand with three restrained notes in S09.
edit.end_card: Composite the official logo and exact Japanese copy in deterministic post-production.

negative_prompt: Different house, invalid generated exterior, generated UI, generated plans, generated text, altered logo, wall/opening/stair/roof/furniture drift, camera inside walls or furniture
